pairs: ‘If a man has divorced his wife,
et recedens ab eo duxerit virum alterum,
and she departs from him, she will marry another man.’
So why would he return to her again?
numquid non polluta et contaminata erit mulier illa?
Is not that woman polluted and defiled?
Tu autem fornicata es cum amatoribus multis:
But you have fornicated yourself with many lovers.
et vide ubi non prostrata sis.
and see where you did not debase yourself.
You were sitting in the roadways,
exspectans eos quasi latro in solitudine:
et polluisti terram in fornicationibus tuis,
like a robber in the wilderness.
And you have polluted the land by your fornications and by your wickedness.
Quam ob rem prohibitæ sunt stillæ pluviarum,
For this reason, the rain showers were withheld,
and there were no late season rains.
Frons mulieris meretricis facta est tibi;
You made your face like that of a promiscuous woman;
you were not willing to blush.
Therefore, at least from this moment on,
‘You are my father, the guide of my virginity.’
Why should you be angry unceasingly?
And will you continue in this to the end?
you have spoken and done evil,
for you were able to do so.”
Et dixit Dominus ad me in diebus Josiæ regis:
And, in the days of king Josiah, the Lord said to me:
Numquid vidisti quæ fecerit aversatrix Israël?
“Have you not seen what the apostate Israel has done?
Abiit sibimet super omnem montem excelsum,
She has brought herself up to every lofty mountain,
and she has lain down under every leafy tree,
and she has committed fornication there.
And when she had done all these things,
Et vidit prævaricatrix soror ejus Juda
And her deceitful sister Judah saw this:
quia pro eo quod mœchata esset aversatrix Israël,
that because the apostate Israel had committed adultery,
I had dismissed her and had given her a bill of divorce.
Yet her deceitful sister Judah was not afraid.
et non timuit prævaricatrix Juda soror ejus,
et facilitate fornicationis suæ contaminavit terram,
And by the act of her fornication,
For she committed adultery with that which is stone and wood.
et in omnibus his non est reversa ad me prævaricatrix soror ejus Juda in toto corde suo,
And after all these things, her deceitful sister Judah has not returned to me with her whole heart,
And the Lord said to me:
Justificavit animam suam aversatrix Israël, comparatione prævaricatricis Judæ.
“The apostate Israel has justified her own soul by comparing herself to the deceitful Judah.
et clama sermones istos contra aquilonem,
and proclaim these words toward the north,
et non avertam faciem meam a vobis,
For I will not avert my face from you.
and I will not be angry forever.
So then, truly acknowledge your iniquity,
quia in Dominum Deum tuum prævaricata es,
that you have betrayed the Lord your God,
et dispersisti vias tuas alienis sub omni ligno frondoso,
and that you have spread your ways to strangers, under every leafy tree,
and that you have not listened to my voice,
et assumam vos unum de civitate,
And so, I will take you, one from a city,
and I will lead you into Zion.
Et dabo vobis pastores juxta cor meum,
And I will give you pastors according to my own heart.
et pascent vos scientia et doctrina.
And they will feed you with knowledge and doctrine.
And when you have been multiplied and increased in the land in those days,
et creveritis in terra in diebus illis,
‘The Ark of the covenant of the Lord!’
And it will not enter into the heart,
and they will not call it to mind.
In tempore illo vocabunt Jerusalem solium Domini:
In that time, Jerusalem will be called: ‘The Throne of the Lord.’
et congregabuntur ad eam omnes gentes in nomine Domini in Jerusalem,
And all the nations will be gathered to it, in the name of the Lord, in Jerusalem.
et non ambulabunt post pravitatem cordis sui pessimi.
And they will not walk after the depravity of their own most wicked heart.
In diebus illis ibit domus Juda ad domum Israël,
In those days, the house of Judah will go to the house of Israel,
et venient simul de terra aquilonis ad terram quam dedi patribus vestris.
and they will come from the land of the north, at the same time, to the land that I gave to your fathers.
How shall I place you among the sons,
and distribute to you a desirable land,
the preeminent inheritance of the host of the Gentiles?
et post me ingredi non cessabis.
and you will not cease to walk after me.
Sed quomodo si contemnat mulier amatorem suum,
But, in the same way that a woman spurns her lover,
so also has the house of Israel spurned me,
A voice has been heard in the highways,
the weeping and wailing of the sons of Israel.
For they have made their own ways sinful;
they have forgotten the Lord their God.
And I will heal your rebelliousness.”
tu enim es Dominus Deus noster.
For you are the Lord our God!
with the multitude of the mountains.
vere in Domino Deo nostro salus Israël.
Truly, the salvation of Israel is in the Lord our God.
Confusio comedit laborem patrum nostrorum ab adolescentia nostra:
Confusion has devoured the labor of our fathers, from our youth,
with their flocks and their herds,
with their sons and their daughters.
We will sleep in our confusion,
and our disgrace will cover us.
quoniam Domino Deo nostro peccavimus nos,
For we have sinned against the Lord our God:
ab adolescentia nostra usque ad diem hanc:
from our youth, even to this day.
et non audivimus vocem Domini Dei nostri.
And we have not listened to the voice of the Lord our God.”
